---
title: "Literature Review"
---

Phase 0 of plan v3 (2026-10-31): the two closest learned-order papers, read in full.
The wider landscape is the table in `plans/research_plan_v3.md` ("已有工作与空白").

## Closest work

| | 2607.08056 (Ouyang et al.) | SAS, 2606.23567 (Xu et al.) |
|---|---|---|
| Model | MMaDA-8B, multimodal | LLaDA-8B, text |
| Base frozen? | Not stated; Alg. 1 updates one shared θ | Yes (§4); optional θ fine-tune on Sudoku only |
| Code | None found | Public: `jimmyxu123/SAS_code`, GSM8K policy checkpoint |
| Policy input | Last-layer hidden states, step index, mask flag | Top-1 prob, entropy, normalized position |
| Policy size | Not stated (UPM from DCoLT, 2505.10446) | ~0.33M (code: 2-layer, d 128) |
| Action | Top-K set, K fixed per step: **D-order** | One position per step: **D-order**, sequential |
| Reward | 2·correct + 0.4·format | Teacher-forced likelihood of the gold completion |
| Training data | VLAA-Thinker digit + multiple-choice subsets | GSM8K / MBPP train |
| Compute | 8×A100, 5,000 steps, 12 rollouts per prompt | 4×H200, ~200 steps, ~12 GPU-h |
| NFE reported? | No | No |
| MathVerse / LLaDA-V / cache | None | None |

## Headline results

- 2607.08056: MathVista_MINI 27.7 → 29.0, MMMU 0.27 → 0.31, GQA 48.6 → 47.6.
- 2607.08056: single runs, no error bars, so gains are not separable from noise.
- 2607.08056: Fig. 3 shows the baseline collapsing to one-token answers.
- Part of its gain may be fixing that collapse, absent in LLaDA-V.
- SAS: GSM8K 0.628 → 0.760 at 256 tokens, one token per step.
- SAS: left-to-right order ties or beats SAS at short lengths (Table 11).
- SAS: run in parallel top-k zero-shot, the policy degrades (Table 7).

## What this changes in plan v3

- **Gaps confirmed.** Neither paper uses LLaDA-V, MathVerse, NFE, token analysis or caches.
- **D-order first.** Both baselines are D-order, so D-order is the fair comparison.
- **Add a left-to-right baseline.** SAS's own Table 11 makes it mandatory in phase A.
- **SAS-style baseline must be retrained.** Our steps commit k > 1 tokens; its sequential policy degrades there.
- **SAS reward needs gold reasoning text.** MathVerse has answers only; options below.
- **Option 1: training set with reasoning traces.** Keep the likelihood reward unchanged.
- **Option 2: swap to a correctness reward.** Record it as a deviation from SAS.
- **SAS reward cost.** One forward per revealed token, with ~2.3k image-heavy prompt tokens.
- **2607.08056-style baseline is a rebuild.** No code; UPM internals come from DCoLT.
- **Freeze the base for it too.** Its freezing is ambiguous; record this as a deviation.
- **Training set.** VLAA-Thinker subsets match 2607.08056; dedup against MathVerse still applies.
- **Compute.** 2607.08056-scale RL (12 rollouts, 5k steps) exceeds the phase-D estimate.
